capabilities: Import broker CSV exports with preview and duplicate detection
Add trades manually with multiple partial exits
Capture chart screenshots in a print queue and attach them to trades
Write structured trade reviews with an automatic completion checklist
Analyze results with an equity curve, performance calendar and breakdowns by strategy, session, symbol and day
extras: Only Tradovate and TradeSea export formats are supported; mobile layouts are still incomplete and the hosted review covered desktop only. Uninstalling deletes data.json, so settings must be exported first.
motivation: The author built it "to keep trades, screenshots and reviews together in Obsidian" so they can "come back later to understand what happened."
problem: Traders keeping their journal in Obsidian have no structured way to import trades, attach chart context, run review checklists and analyze P&L in one place.

relations.evidence: The TradeSea orders export, one checked export per import batch

summary: Futures trading journal that stores trades, screenshots and reviews as Markdown files in the vault, with account tracking and performance analysis.
